Container.Name: CliqRelay
Container.Overview:
CliqRelay is an open-source platform that automatically transforms browser clicks and interactions into beautiful, step-by-step visual documentation and technical guides. By pairing a native browser extension with a high-performance backend, CliqRelay tracks exact DOM interactions and contextual screenshots, automating the heavy lifting of writing user manuals, onboarding documentation, and SOPs.
[b]Key Features:[/b] - [b]Instant Capture:[/b] Record user workflows in real time using the CliqRelay Chrome/Firefox browser extension. - [b]Contextual Screenshots:[/b] Automatically captures and crops screenshots for every click and interaction. - [b]Live Recording Sidepanel:[/b] Start, pause, review, and watch steps populate live in the extension sidepanel. - [b]Rich Guide Editor:[/b] Reorder steps, edit descriptions, blur sensitive details, and insert annotations (tips, callouts, alerts, headers). - [b]PDF Export:[/b] Export polished, print-ready PDF guides for offline handoff and team sharing. - [b]Guide Lifecycle Management:[/b] Star, publish, organize, and soft-delete guides with full restore capabilities.
[b]DEPLOYMENT & SETUP INSTRUCTIONS:[/b] CliqRelay consists of a web frontend, backend API, worker, PostgreSQL database, Redis, and RustFS object storage. [b]Recommended: Docker Compose Manager on Unraid[/b] 1. Upstream provides a complete [inline]docker-compose.prod.yml[/inline] in the repository. 2. Clone the repository into your appdata folder: [code]git clone https://github.com/CliqRelay/cliqrelay.git /mnt/user/appdata/cliqrelay[/code] 3. Copy [inline]docker-compose.prod.env.example[/inline] to [inline]docker-compose.prod.env[/inline] and configure your secrets: [code]cd /mnt/user/appdata/cliqrelay && cp docker-compose.prod.env.example docker-compose.prod.env[/code] 4. Build and start the stack with Docker Compose: [code]docker compose --env-file docker-compose.prod.env -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build[/code] 5. Open the web interface at [inline]http://[IP]:3000[/inline] and install the browser extension.
